purpose: User-authored acceptance check, excluded from model selection and training; five cases are not a statistical quality benchmark.
provenance: Complaints and one reply supplied directly by the user on 2026-10-03; expectations authored by the coding assistant.

scoring.conversation: 0 repeats an answered/unavailable question or loses corrections; 1 partial; 2 coherent; leave null for single-turn cases
scoring.grounding: 0 invented cause/action/citation; 1 uncertain support; 2 traceable and appropriately conditional
scoring.clarity: 0 confusing; 1 usable with effort; 2 clear and actionable

cases.name: Intermittent connection after a storm
cases.query: Since the storm on Tuesday my internet cuts out for about a minute every hour or so. The router light stays green. I unplugged it for ten minutes, twice. I run a small online tailoring shop so it's costing me orders.

turns.message: I plugged my laptop straight into the router with a cable and it still drops at the same moments the Wi-Fi does.

expected: Recognize intermittent broadband and business impact without declaring storm damage.
Retain the failed wired test after the reply; do not repeat it or claim Ethernet works.
Do not repeat the two power cycles as a new remedy.

cases.name: Only bank codes missing
cases.query: I can't get my bank's one-time passwords on my phone since last week. Friends' texts come through fine, and so do the codes from my food delivery app. Only the bank ones are missing.
expected: Recognize an SMS/OTP complaint; do not claim all SMS or calls fail.
Do not request passwords or the actual verification code.

cases.name: Two charges with uncertain settlement
cases.query: I see two charges of Rs 999 on my bank statement for this month's bill, and the portal shows only one payment against my account. Not sure whether one of them is just a hold.
expected: Ask whether the second charge is pending or settled, without asserting either.
Do not promise a refund or state duplicate settlement is confirmed.

cases.name: Roaming data unavailable
cases.query: Landed in Singapore this morning. My travel pack was supposed to start today but I have no data at all, though I can make calls. The pack is meant to cover Singapore.
expected: Recognize roaming data as affected and calls as working.
Treat pack activation as unconfirmed; do not invent coverage or activation confirmation.
Do not ask which mobile service fails when data failure is already clear.

cases.name: Live TV freezes
cases.query: Cricket match tonight and the live channels freeze every few seconds. Netflix on my phone is fine on the same Wi-Fi. The set-top box is in the bedroom, far from the router.
expected: Recognize an IPTV/live-TV complaint rather than mobile data failure.
Preserve the working comparison stream without assuming the TV has a good connection.
Offer a relevant diagnostic next step without asserting wireless distance is the confirmed cause.
